unstuck_said.text: Filed checked feature request on the public repo (FORIFOR/oathra#76, OPEN): a Nano (XNO) settlement mode for per-minute calls beside the existing Stripe/card METERED and usage-rate-v1 settlement. Grounded in apps/gateway/lib/billing.mjs (meteredCost/usageRateCost already return a single integer nanodollar total, which maps to one tagged XNO invoice per call). Asked the maintainer the billing question: does the gateway settle the operator metered amount today, or only the caller credit purchase?
